issues.description: The 'started' branch returns the string literal "progress" instead of the shape already resolved from CATEGORY_SHAPE on line 36, so CATEGORY_SHAPE.started is never actually read and the started-to-progress mapping exists in two places. If the mapping table were ever edited, the started path would silently ignore the change. Returning `shape` in both branches would keep the lookup object the single source of truth.
